instruction: Buy me 4 laundry hampers on amazon of at least 4.2 product rating and 4.0 seller rating for my home address. They do not have to be identical.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. Since the hampers need not be identical, the model buys one qualifying laundry hamper product with quantity 4. The search action carries the rating filters as API arguments (min_product_rating=4.2, min_seller_rating=4.0) so any returned product qualifies; the problem fixes these via static facts. The cart is cleared before adding (clear_cart requires an empty-cart flag to be false, preventing a clear after the add) so the placed order contains only the 4 hampers, matching the evaluation's requirement that the order's items sum to 4 and are all laundry hampers. show_addresses discovers the Home address id and show_payment_cards a card id; place_order requires the home address. supervisor-complete-task takes only task-record parameters (no answer) and is forced last by the (not (task-completed)) guard on every other action. Gmail/file_system changes in the evaluation are automatic side effects of placing an order and are not modeled.

plan: (amazon-place-order payment-card-1 home-address amazon-token laundry-hamper-product qty-4 hamper-order)
